bio.text: April McClain Delaney was elected in 2024 to represent Maryland's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House.
She grew up in Buhl, Idaho, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northwestern University and a Juris Doctor from Georgetown University.

Before Congress she was Deputy Assistant Secretary of Commerce for communications at the National Telecommunications and Information Administration and Director of Washington, D.C., for Common Sense Media.
She lives in Montgomery County, Maryland.
